entity: House members running for Senate in the 2026 cycle: missed-vote rates during campaign season
what_we_add: Median rates 1.8% to 3.5% for the 16, and the placebo: the same 16 rose 0.3% to 2.4% in the same months of 2023-24
why: Legis1 and Deseret name the class, House members seeking higher office, and report the same finding in the same direction: they miss far more votes while campaigning. No source has the group medians or the two-years-earlier placebo comparison that undercuts the campaign explanation.
